awaiting_human_approval.description:
A GamCryp Short explaining why points-based opportunities like Grass may be useful to track while ROI remains unavailable.

Explore the source-backed opportunity: https://gamcryp.com/opportunities/grass?utm_campaign=distribution-mvp&utm_content=x-grass-roi-unavailable-20260831&utm_medium=short&utm_source=youtube
awaiting_human_approval.short_script: Grass is a good example of a Web3 earning opportunity where GamCryp should not invent ROI. The user contributes bandwidth and may earn points. But points are not the same as a realizable market return. GamCryp marks ROI unavailable until a lawful, reproducible value route exists. That protects users from fake precision.
awaiting_human_approval.title: Grass: why GamCryp says ROI unavailable

blocked.description:
A GamCryp Short showing why DIMO's vehicle-data rewards need cost, eligibility, risk, and confidence shown together.

Explore the source-backed opportunity: https://gamcryp.com/strategies/dimo-software-only-compatible-car?utm_campaign=distribution-mvp&utm_content=x-dimo-subscription-catch-20260831&utm_medium=short&utm_source=youtube
blocked.short_script: DIMO is a DePIN vehicle-data project. The user connects a compatible car and may receive DIMO rewards. GamCryp's software-only scenario uses $8.99 of capital, -$0.2994/day net, and -99.91% 30D ROI. That is not a verdict on the project. It is the current modeled scenario. The major catch is that rewards depend on vehicle eligibility, network points, and recurring costs.
blocked.title: DIMO: vehicle data rewards need the cost side

blocked.description:
A GamCryp data-backed Short explaining GEODNET's modeled base-station economics and why high ROI can still carry very high risk.

Explore the source-backed opportunity: https://gamcryp.com/strategies/geodnet-empty-hex-triple-band-base-station?utm_campaign=distribution-mvp&utm_content=x-geodnet-rank-risk-20260831&utm_medium=short&utm_source=youtube
blocked.short_script: GEODNET is one of the clearest examples of why ROI alone is not enough. The user runs a geospatial base station. GamCryp's current scenario uses $695 of modeled capital, $2.56/day of net earnings, and 11.05% 30D ROI. But this is an empty-hex, quality-dependent model. If your location, signal, or competition is worse, the result can change sharply. Use GamCryp to inspect the numbers, confidence, and risk before treating the model as useful.
blocked.title: GEODNET ROI looks strong. Here is the catch.
